summary: Inlined MSVC locale/stream object construction. Registers an SEH handler, conditionally installs a streambuf vtable and the std::ios vtable plus a construction-completed flag, writes the std::ostream vtable into the sub-object slot derived from the installed vtable, and conditionally initializes a sub-object via ObjectInitWithVTableFlagSet. Returns the constructed object pointer.

operations.description: SEH handler registration for the constructor frame.
Read the flag at this+0x14 (a1+20); if zero, the stream sub-object initialization block is skipped.
Store the constructed object pointer into the stack slot at a1-20 and clear the construction-completed flag at a1-16.
In the non-zero branch: set *v5 to the streambuf vtable (unk_5B9BB8), zero v5[10], set v5[1] to the std::ios vtable, set the construction-completed flag at a1-16 to 1, and zero the slot at a1-4.
Write the std::ostream vtable into the sub-object slot located by the embedded offset read from the installed vtable (v5 + *(*(v5)+4)).
Read the flag at this+0x10 (a1+16); if zero, the sub-object initialization call is skipped.
In the non-zero branch: call ObjectInitWithVTableFlagSet with this+0x8 and this+0xC as arguments.

unresolved: The exception-handling type descriptor loc_59D23E participates in the SEH frame but is not referenced by name in the visible constructor body.
The a1-relative stack slots (a1-20, a1-16, a1-4) belong to the inlined caller frame; the exact object layout they describe is not recoverable from this function alone.
